notes.title: Co-Op Mode Update
notes.notes:
We've updated to add a new mode: Co-Op. 

See our announcement for more details.

notes.title: Chex Quest HD: v111637 Patch
notes.notes:
[b]UPDATE[/b]: We've fixed a Steam configuration issue which was preventing installation of the Mac OS version of the game. 

We've released an update, which addresses a handful of issues (see below). 

[b]ADJUSTMENTS + ADDITIONS[/b]
[list]
[*] A Mac OS version of the game is now available
[*] HUD size has been reduced in single-player to make more of the world visible
[*] An option has been added to the Main Menu that enables toggling Head Bob on/off
[/list]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused some players to get stuck in the ship at the end of level 1
[*] Fixed an issue with audio lines being cut off on pick up, or death
[*] Fixed unusual Shane looking animations, firing animations for some weapons
[*] Fixed an issue causing some players to get stuck under the moving platform at the beginning of level 2
[*] Several other minor fixes and improvements
[/list]
